title: Mackenzie landscape biodiversity order
description: The 2008 Mackenzie non-spatial landscape biodiversity objectives as amended in 2010: old forest and old interior forest retention by landscape unit and biogeoclimatic group, the younger-stand allowance, and the Wildlands landscape units. The reviewer reads the targets from the order's tables; PGMaps does not yet calculate them for Mackenzie.

facts.label: Does the order apply to the block: Crown land in the Mackenzie Forest District, outside woodlots, research forests and community forests of 600 ha or less?
Old forest in the block's unit and group after the harvest, minus the 2010 Table 2 target
Old interior forest after the harvest, minus the Table 3 target
Share of the live old forest target met by stands younger than old
Has it been demonstrated that the younger stands give equal or better conservation benefits?
Is the block in a Wildlands landscape unit (Bluff Creek, Braid, Frog, McCusker, North or South Firesteel, Upper Akie River, Upper Gataga, Upper Pelly, Wicked River)?
